# Vice Chair

Begin Vice Chair is a pivotal role, that involves supporting the chairperson in 
running the club, stepping in as leader when the chair is absent, and helping 
manage daily operations and committee meetings.

Often the Vice Chair steps into the Chair position when that person steps down.

## Key Responsibilities
- Provide as-needed support and leadership across all club management and governance 
functions
- To prepare and present the annual report in conjunction with the Club Chair and 
Secretary
- Attend all committee meetings

## Requirements
- Registration with Swim England
- Current DBS certificate
